messages.subject: Cleaning genoprobs prior to scan1
parts:
Hello Karl and others,

I was wondering what your recommendations were with using the clean_genoprobs() function before running any genome scan with scan1. 

From what I understand extremely small probabilities can result in more unusually high coefficients with scan1 coef. I also assume since scan1 is fitting regression model to obtain RSS values which is then used to calculate LOD scores. LOD scores will also be affected by these small probabilities.

When I test this I do see that the lod curves after cleaning seem much smoother. Without these spikes which i assume is due to the small probabilities.

I don't see any real downside with using the clean function to get rid of these extremely small probabilities.


Thanks
Senthil
